info.title: Contactless Airlock Lab Simulator Outbox
info.description: Simulator-only contract for the local SQLite outbox record and claim lifecycle. This is not an agreed issuer, processor, wallet/TSP, network, or merchant event contract.

localSimulatorStore.description: Conceptual AsyncAPI representation of an in-process SQLite API. No broker or partner endpoint exists.

simulatorOutbox.description: The single local SQLite outbox table. Topic is record metadata used by a future dispatcher, not a routed SQLite channel or an implemented broker destination.

claimSimulatorOutbox.summary: Claim a bounded batch for a leased, at-least-once simulator delivery attempt

simulatorOutboxRecord.name: airlock.simulator.outbox-record.v1
simulatorOutboxRecord.title: Simulator outbox record version 1
simulatorOutboxRecord.summary: Internal leased delivery record, not a partner wire envelope

x-versioning.location: AsyncAPI message name and schema reference

x-idempotency.producerGuarantee: SQLite UNIQUE(event_key) rejects duplicate enqueue in the database lifetime.
x-idempotency.consumerRequirement: Consumers must deduplicate eventKey or eventId because delivery is at least once.

x-retry.eligibleWhen: deliveredAt is absent, availableAt is due, and claimedUntil is absent or expired
x-retry.attemptCounter: attempts increments when a lease is successfully claimed
x-retry.acknowledgement: acknowledgeOutbox succeeds only while the caller owns an unexpired lease, marks deliveredAt, and clears ownership
x-retry.explicitRelease: releaseOutbox succeeds only while the caller owns an unexpired lease, clears ownership, and moves availableAt to the supplied retry time
x-retry.crashRecovery: an unacknowledged event becomes eligible after claimedUntil
x-retry.orderingGuarantee: claim scan orders by createdAt then eventId; no cross-worker delivery-order guarantee

topic.description: Opaque caller-supplied simulator topic; no registry is enforced.

aggregateId.description: Opaque aggregate grouping; not a complete correlation/causation envelope.

payload.description: Caller-supplied JSON value. The current store enforces no topic-specific payload schema.

attempts.description: Number of successful lease claims, not business-processing attempts.

claimedUntil.description: Lease expiry; another worker may claim after this instant.

deliveredAt.description: Local acknowledgement time; not proof a production partner committed an effect.
